rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved or sponsored by AVMA and its specialty groups, regional meetings (e.g. Central and Western Veterinary Conference), state/provincial and affiliated local VMAs, AAHA, AVMA-accredited schools, state veterinary academies, AAVSB RACE, the Missouri State Veterinarian, or with prior Board approval; recordings and electronic/interactive programs from these sponsors
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the reporting period in which the licensee graduates and is first licensed in Missouri.
rules.carryover: Up to 10 excess hours (excluding self-study) to the next reporting period only.
rules.alternatives: Waiver or extension up to 6 months for good cause (armed forces, illness, undue hardship); a graduate resident program satisfies the year; CE for another state may count if substantially equal.
rules.audit_note: Board audits; keep records for the current and two previous reporting periods.
rules.notes: Reporting period Dec 1 - Nov 30; renewal form due by Nov 30. Max 2 h journal self-study; max 4 h non-scientific seminars and 4 h non-scientific recorded/electronic programs.
